name: Ecommerce AI video skills for Claude Code and AI agents

themes.format: Hands-only ASMR unboxing, native sound, no music
themes.evidence: Highest winner rate of any Meta ad format (9.8%) while only 2.1% of ads use it (Motion 2026, 578,750 ads)
themes.cost_note: 10 s Seedance 2.5 with audio (385 credits) + box image (5)
themes.say_to_agent: Make a 10 s ASMR unboxing of this product: <photo URL>. No box photo, make one.

themes.format: Problem → 'Vs…' → solution, music and text, no voice
fits: gadget that fixes an everyday annoyance
themes.evidence: Five-beat reel structure posted daily by TikTok and Instagram product pages; broken down from a live reel (Oct 2026)
themes.cost_note: ≈ $7–9: 2 Kling 4 clips + 2–3 Seedance 2.5 clips + music (23 credits)
themes.say_to_agent: Make a 20 s problem → Vs → solution reel for <product>, music only, sentence-case text with emoji.

themes.format: 60 s dropshipping guide reel: hook, laptop and pen, price math, steps, 'Comment GUIDE'
themes.evidence: Posted every day by @tradelle and its affiliates on Instagram (Oct 2026)
themes.cost_note: ~860 credits per product after the first (~1,250)
themes.say_to_agent: Make a dropshipping guide reel for <photo URL>. Cost $6.80, sells for $34.99. Hook: backyard security camera.

themes.format: Viral product hook: security cam, torture test, satisfying close-up, gift reaction, before/after
fits: gadget or tool with a visible effect
any product, as the first 3 s of an ad
themes.evidence: The first 3 s decide the ad; these archetypes recur in top TikTok Shop videos
themes.say_to_agent: Find a hook that already sells this kind of product and remake it with <photo URL>.

themes.format: Singing mascot jingle: the product as a clay character
themes.evidence: AI 'musical' ads with singing cartoon narrators ran by the thousand on Meta and Google in 2026; many were pulled for health claims (CNN, 2026-10-28)
themes.cost_note: mascot image (5) + Lyria jingle (10) + 15 s Seedance 2.5 with audio reference (578)
themes.say_to_agent: Turn <product> into a claymation mascot that sings a 15 s jingle with the brand name in the hook.

themes.format: Try-on fit check from a flat-lay
themes.evidence: Shows drape and size, the two things clothes buyers can't check online
themes.say_to_agent: Put this <garment flat-lay URL> on a model and make a 5 s fit check: turn, tug, size caption.

themes.format: 20 variants of a winning ad: new hooks, personas, formats
themes.evidence: After Meta's Andromeda update look-alike ads compete as one; sellers test 20–40 creatives a week
themes.cost_note: $0.01 per spoken hook line on existing clips; $2.32 with a new 6 s hook clip
themes.say_to_agent: Turn this winning ad <URL> into 20 variants: 7 new concepts and 13 single-variable iterations, with a test plan.

themes.format: Competitor winner remix: a new angle on a proven structure
themes.evidence: Ads running 30+ days with 5+ variants are being scaled (agency heuristic); ideas and structures are free to reuse, footage is not
themes.cost_note: 5 credits per ad analysed; production cost depends on the format
themes.say_to_agent: Here are 8 competitor ads from the Meta Ad Library: <URLs>. Break them down and give me 15 new concepts for <product>.

themes.format: The winner in a new market: transcreated, same voice, re-cut
themes.evidence: TikTok Shop opened AT, BE, NL and PL in June 2026 after DE, FR, IT and ES in 2025
themes.cost_note: ElevenLabs v4 voiceover (8 credits) for a faceless ad; lip-sync extra
themes.say_to_agent: Localize this ad <URL> for TikTok Shop Mexico and Germany with an offer card per market.

themes.format: AI UGC creator ad: a talking actor reads your script
themes.evidence: The default paid-social format; must carry AI labels and no first-person 'I used it' claims (FTC 16 CFR 465)
themes.cost_note: depends on length and avatar model
themes.say_to_agent: Make a 20 s UGC ad for <product> with an AI creator, labelled as AI.

always_use.when: whenever the product appears in a generated shot
always_use.cost_note: 5 credits per side-profile reference + 5 per drift check
